content.outcome: Provide deterministic local search and knowledge discovery over Change 014 site routes with source traceability and stable ranking.

classification.reason: Search changes reader discovery behavior and must not silently elevate inferred or unregistered material.

authority_model: Search indexes only registered publication-derived site routes.
Search ranking changes discoverability but never fact authority.
Every result retains family, surface, source, and route traceability.
requirements: R1: Search MUST index only current governed site routes.
R2: Search documents MUST retain stable IDs and source/family/surface provenance.
R3: Ranking MUST be deterministic with stable tie-breaking.
R4: Validation MUST reject stale site output, missing sources, duplicate routes, stale search output, and tampering.
R5: The reader site MUST expose a static search surface without a network search dependency.
R6: Hosting and deployment remain excluded.
implementation_plan: P1: Build a deterministic static inverted index from Change 014 routes.
P2: Add stable query ranking and traceable result envelopes.
P3: Integrate the index into the generated site as a client-side search surface.
P4: Add build/validate/exact verification to CLI and canonical verification.
verification_criteria: V1: Search index covers current site source routes and no unregistered content.
V2: Repeated queries return the same order.
V3: Stale site and tampered search output are detected.
V4: Full repository verification passes with canonical MRDs unchanged.

tasks.text: Raise issue and governed change records.
Implement deterministic search index and site discovery surface.
Verify, review, publish, merge, and reconcile.

risks: Ranking may imply authority if result provenance is hidden.
Search may become stale if site freshness is not a prerequisite.
